title: server.command
description: A deterministic voice command asks the client to act (ADR-0006); the client answers with ack carrying command_id.

command_id.description: Echoed by the client ack and by the capture upload it triggers.

command.description: capture_now: take a burst of stills and upload them with trigger command.

server_time_ms.description: Backend clock, Unix epoch ms, when the message was sent.
